messages.subject: For Massimo Battaini | Energy infrastructure, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Bifulco,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Massimo Battaini, Chief Executive Officer.

Prysmian's global role across power grids, interconnectors and digital infrastructure places governments, regulators, communities and strategic partners at the center of long-term execution. That interface closely matches my current leadership mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, public affairs and infrastructure stakeholder execution might support Prysmian's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Prysmian.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
